```{=html}
<div id="map-aug05" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug05').setView([35.1720, 129.2000], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 L7 Haeundae by Lotte Hotels', lat:35.1602318553241, lng:129.1600771067464, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=L7+Haeundae+by+Lotte+Hotels+Busan' },
    { name:'Sky Capsule & Blueline Park 🚡', lat:35.1637, lng:129.1856, c:'#1565C0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Haeundae+Blueline+Park+Sky+Capsule+Busan' },
    { name:'Jangteo Gukbap 🍲', lat:35.1580, lng:129.1620, c:'#43A047', url:'https://share.google/yZXgYF1o7yxzcPRW7' },
    { name:'Haedong Yonggungsa Temple 🏯', lat:35.1878, lng:129.2230, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Haedong+Yonggungsa+Temple+Busan' },
    { name:'Standard Bread Haeundae 🍞', lat:35.1590, lng:129.1610, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://share.google/gim9vKPZZlnmpHmJb' },
    { name:'Haeundae Beach (sunset) 🌅', lat:35.1587, lng:129.1604, c:'#5C6BC0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Haeundae+Beach+Busan' },
    { name:'첨벙 Cheombeong 🐟 (Sashimi)', lat:35.1592, lng:129.1635, c:'#2E7D32', url:'https://share.google/YoWNAZXPOVPTer4XO' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Morning — Sky Capsule</div>

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-05T08:30" data-lat="35.1637" data-lng="129.1856">
  <div class="event-time">08:30–09:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag booked">BOOKED ✓</span><span class="tag activity">🚡 Ride</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Sky Capsule (Cheongsapo Departure) — Haeundae Blueline Park</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Pastel-coloured glass pod trains that ride along a coastal rail above the sea cliffs. One of Busan's most iconic and photogenic experiences. Reservation confirmed — entry window is <strong>8:30–9:00 AM</strong>.
      <ul>
        <li>~2.7km coastal route from Mipo to Cheongsapo</li>
        <li>Pods seat 2 people, ~30 min round trip</li>
        <li>Best views looking out to sea on the left side going northbound</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Haeundae+Blueline+Park+Sky+Capsule+Busan" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Sky Capsule</a>

      <a href="https://www.tbluelinepark.com/mypage/login_eng/GD2100048" target="_blank" class="maps-link">🎫 Retrieve Ticket</a>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Lunch</div>

<div class="event-card meal" data-dt="2026-08-05T12:00" data-lat="35.1580" data-lng="129.1620">
  <div class="event-time">12:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag meal">🍲 MUST EAT</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">DWAEJI GUKBAP!!!!! — Jangteo Gukbap</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Busan's most iconic dish — pork soup with rice (돼지국밥). A thick, milky white pork bone broth with tender pork slices and rice. Season with fermented shrimp (새우젓) and green onion. Jangteo Gukbap is right in the Haeundae beach area.</div>
    <div class="event-links">

</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Afternoon — Temple & Cafe</div>

<div class="event-card afternoon" data-dt="2026-08-05T14:30" data-lat="35.1878" data-lng="129.2230">
  <div class="event-time">14:30</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🏯 Temple</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Haedong Yonggungsa Temple</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Rare and stunning Buddhist temple built directly on seaside cliffs. Dragons, pagodas, and golden Buddhas overlooking crashing waves — one of Korea's most dramatic temple settings. ~30 min from Haeundae by taxi/bus.
      <ul>
        <li>Enter through the stone archway at the top and descend to the sea level temple</li>
        <li>Best visited in afternoon when morning crowds thin</li>
        <li>Souvenir stalls and fish-shaped bread (붕어빵) at the entrance</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Haedong+Yonggungsa+Temple+Busan" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Haedong Temple</a>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
